amendment: v1.1 — binds inspected artifact facts (parameters, serving format, training-data structure) recorded 2026-09-08; adds llama.cpp-native CPU-first execution envelope. No gate threshold, status, or non-goal changes.

governing_boundary.rule: Outputs of any run under this contract are proposal/evidence only. Upstream benchmark claims are not local measurements. Silent substitution is forbidden. Production use requires an explicit A11oy receipt bound to the exact candidate and consumer revisions.

training_data_inspected_2026_09_08.response_source: generated by Qwen3.5-0.8B target itself (self-distillation on the exact served distribution)

pairing.authority_invariant: The target model remains the sole authority on emitted tokens. The drafter proposes; the target verifies. Any configuration that lets drafter output bypass target verification is an automatic FAIL regardless of measured speed.

execution_envelope.first_measurement_environment: house CPU lab via llama.cpp speculative decoding (drafter ships GGUF natively; pair with the estate's signed chaski-line GGUF as target)
execution_envelope.second_pass_environment: estate GPU when available (HF Jobs or owner metal)
execution_envelope.note: The drafter's native GGUF/llama.cpp format removes the hard GPU prerequisite for the first measurement pass. CPU acceptance-rate and decode-uplift numbers are valid contract evidence; GPU numbers extend the envelope.

measurements_required.definition: Fraction of drafter-proposed tokens accepted by the target under the estate verification loop
measurements_required.label: MEASURED only when produced on estate-controlled hardware

measurements_required.definition: End-to-end decode throughput of target+drafter vs. target-only baseline, identical prompts, identical hardware
measurements_required.label: MEASURED only when produced on estate-controlled hardware

measurements_required.definition: Distribution parity of speculative output vs. target-only output on the estate gate suite (JSON-draft, refusal, honesty corpus)
measurements_required.label: MEASURED

measurements_required.definition: Peak memory and load-time overhead introduced by the drafter, CPU and GPU recorded separately
measurements_required.label: MEASURED

gate_thresholds.note: Thresholds are integration-proposal criteria only. Meeting them authorizes writing a proposal, not shipping.

non_goals: No Hugging Face repository is created, overwritten, or retagged by this contract
No held frontier choice is promoted or ungated
No production serving change is authorized
No upstream benchmark figure may be quoted as a local measurement

receipt_requirement.signing_note: Receipts emit under current signing posture; HMAC PLACEHOLDER labeling applies until A11OY_HMAC_KEY is set, per HONEST_DISCLOSURE.md

provenance.v1_1_inspection: hub_repo_details overviews of satgeze/Qwen3.5-0.8B-DSpark and r3lax/Qwen3.5-0.8B-selfdistill, 2026-09-08
